answer: Ask any carter which road he took, and he will point at the ruts his own wheels made. Proof of beekeeper hive via comb inspection tally points at the ruts: a hive the keeper opens only after 6 comb inspections find no blight, each signed by a different keeper. The tundra is the first rut, cut in the spring mud; the lotus is the second, cut after the harvest. A liar needs 23 false ruts and 23 false wheels to lay them in one night, and the beacon still points the other way.
